posts.cooked:
http://theletterspage.libsyn.com/interlude-6-maintenance-mode

Glad we got the Crisis with Infinite K.N.Y.F.E.s issue worked out.  Honestly I'm surprised at how few nitpicks they decided to do, but that was a big one.

Also good to know that the animal universe is a thing (which I will proceed to call the Sealiverse).

Which raises the question: FILTER clearly has a good grasp on many of the different universes out there.  Did they know about the Sealiverse?  Did they attempt to recruit animal Paige Huntly?  Is there a side-story out there about the adventures of the Furious Energy Leasher Yielding Neutralization?  Presumably Rogue Agent F.E.L.Y.N. escapes the destruction of FILTER, and most likely joins KNYFE on her space-faring adventures.
